finding.comment: pinning discipline: toolkit_ref must remain an immutable SHA; a branch name in this field would silently change release behavior on every upstream push.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/release.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/release.yml
@@ -12,8 +12,8 @@
   publish:
     uses: octo-tools/release-kit/.github/workflows/publish.yml@4ad5c1e9b7d3f20816a45ce2d9b6f3e7c8a190d2b
     with:
-      toolkit_ref: 4ad5c1e9b7d3f20816a45ce2d9b6f3e7c8a190d2b
+      toolkit_ref: 7e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b
       channel: stable
